title: 第24章 来自小机器人的疑惑
novel_title: 我在星际召唤古人，带飞华夏文明
content_zh:
“啦啦啦～”

    花期哼着小曲，光脚踩在独角兽喷水池上，迎着背后的彩虹，展开双手面对镜头微笑。

    “咔嚓——”

    空中白光闪过，个人相册中更新了十来张照片。

    花期检查照片没问题，选中最漂亮的几张，凑成九宫格上传到账号，并设为非公开模式发送。

    [图片][图片][图片][图片]....

    她看着照片中笑容明媚的女孩，精致的眉眼下，是一副病态般的皮肤，颜色在光照下几乎接近透明。

    她又回头望着身后代表着圣洁美好的独角兽，唇间缓缓勾勒出一丝冷笑。

    圣洁美好，花岁岁，你一个完全遗传了生母基因的垃圾，和这几个字扯得上联系吗？

    要说花家几个老登是冷漠无情，你就是垃圾中爬行的蛆虫。

    我，很期待你知道喷泉真相后的反应。

    ......

    接连失窃两笔巨款，花岁岁黑着一张脸回到蓝白星。

    她反复打开账户，望着上面少了七位数的余额，气得浑身发抖。

    该死的小偷，敢偷本小姐的钱。

    ***，和那该死的花期一样，没见过钱的下等人。

    一百五十万，你最好能在一天之内用完，不然等我找到你一定找人弄死你。

    “妹妹，别难过了，不就是五十万，哥给你补上。”

    花言不知道花岁岁又被卷了一百万，看她为丢失了五十万而一直闷闷不乐，贴心地坐在旁边安慰她。

    花父花母也跟着过来，坐在花岁岁对面的沙发上安慰道：

    “是啊宝贝女儿，你太单纯了，大不了这点钱就当交学费了，下次咱们看见陌生链接别点。”

    “没错女儿，妈下午带你去买点衣服，你看你这几天都没睡好，回家了自然要好好放松放松。”

    花岁岁抬起一双湿漉漉的双眸，对着围在她身边嘘寒问暖的三人自嘲地笑了下。
content_en:
"La la la~"

    Hua Qi hummed a tune, stepped barefoot on the unicorn fountain, faced the rainbow behind her, spread her hands and smiled at the camera.

    "Click——"

    A white light flashed in the sky, and a dozen photos were updated in the personal photo album.

    There is no problem with checking the photos during the flowering period. Select the most beautiful ones, put them into a nine-square grid, upload them to the account, and set them to private mode for sending.

    [Picture][Picture][Picture][Picture]....

    She looked at the girl with a bright smile in the photo. Under her delicate eyebrows was a pair of sickly skin, the color of which was almost transparent under the light.

    She looked back at the unicorn behind her, which represented holiness and beauty, and a sneer slowly formed on her lips.

    Holy and beautiful, flowers are blooming every year. You, a piece of trash who has completely inherited your biological mother’s genes, can you be related to these words?

    If you want to say that the elders of the Hua family are cold and heartless, you are just like maggots crawling in the garbage.

    I'm looking forward to your reaction after knowing the truth about the fountain.

    ...

    Two huge sums of money were stolen in succession, and Hua Sui returned to Blue and White Star with a dark face.

    She opened her account repeatedly and looked at the seven-digit balance missing, trembling with anger.

    Damn thief, dare to steal my lady’s money.

    ***, like that damn flower, a low-class person who has never seen money.

    One and a half million, you'd better use it within one day, otherwise I will find someone to kill you when I find you.

    "Sister, don't be sad. It's only half a million. I'll make up for it for you."

    Huayan didn't know that Hua Suisui had been involved in another million. Seeing that she had been depressed because of the loss of half a million, she thoughtfully sat next to her and comforted her.

    Hua's father and mother also came over, sat on the sofa opposite Hua Suisui and comforted:

    "Yes, dear girl, you are too naive. At worst, this little money will be used as tuition fees. Next time we see unfamiliar links, don't click on them."

    "That's right, daughter, mom will take you to buy some clothes this afternoon. You see you haven't slept well these past few days. Naturally, you should relax well when you get home."

    Hua Suisui raised her wet eyes and smiled self-deprecatingly at the three people who gathered around her to inquire about their welfare.
title_en: Chapter 24 Doubts from the little robot
